Coverage is not completion. Prior line-by-line source work was reused after hash checks; five newer source versions were reconciled separately. Previously completed Willy and BigBeluga reviews are retained. Additional parallel reviews are imported only with matching publication metadata and inspected-source hashes. Unavailable or contradictory publications remain explicitly blocked. For the whole retained library, 550 of 2626 author publications are reconciled. Downloaded descriptions are labelled pending; unavailable pages are not treated as reviewed.

Confirmed integration gaps

  • RSI Volume Ladder: the author adds up to three legs and recalculates basket brackets. The bot ignores same-direction adds. A native basket adapter must keep the aggregate $150 budget and risk limits; the current strategy is an adaptation.
  • Absorption Reversal: the source spacing OR can bypass absorption. Lower-timeframe candle delta coverage is also unresolved. Its existing quarantine stays in place.
  • Trend FVG Delta: the author describes discretionary rejection entries; the source draws zones and statistics, not a complete entry condition. Candle-position volume is a proxy.
  • ML RSI classifier and SuperTrend cluster consensus outputs must remain distinct from regime/member flips. The existing comparison variants supply that distinction; generic-reader history is not interchangeable.
  • Trend Impulse continuation, Kinetic's selected marker, Asia-only Killzones and Pivot's long-only reading are deliberate bot variants. Compare alternatives under separate identities.

What changes in the bot

Library → select a script → Author intent and bot reading shows the publication author, reviewed source date, entry conditions, non-entry markers, stop/target/exit logic, timing caveats and current reading. A changed source hides obsolete conditions. Historical claims are scoped to the scanner and labelled as historical; refuted and unchecked claims are excluded. Review records do not change admission, positions, risk or evidence settings. Experimental shadow profiles are enabled separately by a tested operator script; they cannot supply promotion evidence.

Tested shadow rollout

The five available research slots are assigned to author-lifecycle SAVWAP, Synapse and Liquidity Trail, plus exact-direction Pivot Zones and Dynamic Bands signals on ETH 15m. Account enablement stays off. THMA and Liquidity Void corrections are source-tested and await research capacity. All plans retain $150 margin, the 3% stop ceiling and full research fees. The original 25 experiments and the 30-plan maximum are preserved.

Actual Pine runs on 2,000 historical ETH 15m bars produced entries for all seven reviewed profiles. Fourteen sampled prefix checks agreed without future bars. These check event semantics and timing; they do not establish profitability or complete historical depth replay.

Remaining work

Review pending author explanations by family, reconcile every meaningful update against the pinned source, then reproduce each actionable mismatch with real source outputs. New lifecycle adapters need causal fill tests and separate shadow evidence. Preserve context-only roles; do not force every publication to generate entries.
